strings.admin.moderation.title: Moderation
strings.admin.moderation.lede: Local only. Blocking hides content here, discards the data, and so stops this node distributing it. Content you published yourself is kept — this node may be the only copy. No other node is affected, and nothing is reported anywhere.
strings.admin.moderation.blocked: Blocked here and the data discarded. No other node is affected.
strings.admin.privacy.title: Your data
strings.admin.privacy.lede: Everything below is stored in this node's database and nowhere else. None of it has a form it could be sent in — that is the absence of a mechanism, not a setting that switches one off.
strings.admin.privacy.modelLede: Learned from what you watched here.

strings.viewer.channels.title: Channels
strings.viewer.channels.lede: Subscribing follows a person, not a machine. Once you have subscribed you can check for their new work whenever you like, and it keeps working if they move to another computer.
strings.viewer.channels.hint: Ask someone for their link. They will find it on their own node's admin page.
strings.viewer.channels.empty: You are not subscribed to anyone yet.
strings.viewer.channel.unsubscribed: Unsubscribed. The videos you already have are still here.
strings.viewer.channel.nothing: Nothing from this channel has reached this device yet.
strings.admin.channel.title: Your channel link
strings.admin.channel.lede: Give this to anyone who wants to follow what you publish. It names you, not this machine.
strings.viewer.channels.subscribed_none: Subscribed to {name}. Nothing new yet — anything they publish will turn up.
strings.viewer.channels.clash.title: Another identity on this device uses the same display name. Compare the key.
strings.viewer.channels.clash.warning_one: Careful: this device already knows {count} other identity calling itself {name}. A name is not owned by anyone — there is no register of names for it to be owned in. Check the key against the one you were given.
strings.viewer.channels.clash.warning_other: Careful: this device already knows {count} other identities calling themselves {name}. A name is not owned by anyone — there is no register of names for it to be owned in. Check the key against the one you were given.
strings.admin.publish.lede: The network carries the title, tags, thumbnail and the hashes the file must match. It does not carry the file: viewers fetch that from your own server, and check what arrives against the hashes.
strings.admin.publish.sourceUrlHint: Must serve this exact file, and must answer range requests so playback can start without downloading all of it. If you later change the file there, every viewer will see that it no longer matches.
strings.admin.publish.noSourceUrl: Give the address viewers will fetch the file from.
